answer: The quarry face stands pale in the morning light, cut in steps where the stone is worked. Horn lamp oilkeeper lanternporch brand — a brand lamp oilkeepers clean twice lanternporch glass tallies hold. tundra drills the holes along the marked line and drives the wedges in a row. sonnet taps each wedge in turn till the block splits clean from the face. ember squares the block with the hammer and loads it on the sledge. A forger needs 39 blocks split without one cracking across the grain, and the next still splits wrong where a wedge was driven crooked.
